title: Lion
lyrics_plain:
Another time, another place
Where evil reigns
Killing and terror rules
The innocent must pay
I can't stand this world
No one seems to care
Wanna leave it all behind
Is there a sense of honor
Why can't we all live like brothers?

Like a lion in a cage
I don't know who to praise
Like a lion in a cage
Nowhere to go, my silent rage
Like a lion in a cage!
Like a lion in, like a lion in
Like a lion in a cage!

I will prevail, these iron bars won't hold me back
Victorious, I'll break free from my mental jail
We are born alone, and we'll die alone
Only the strong will survive
Hold the weakest's hand
Why can't we all live like equals?

Like a lion in a cage
I don't know who to praise
Like a lion in a cage
Nowhere to go, my silent rage
Like a lion in a cage!
Like a lion in, like a lion in
Like a lion in a cage!

Can't stand this world
No one seems to care
I wanna leave it all far behind
Is there a sense of honor?
Why cant we all live like brothers?

Like a lion in a cage
I just don't know who to praise
Like a lion in a cage
Nowhere to go, my silent rage
Like a lion in a cage
Nothing seems to cure my pain
Though my roars are real
I'm a wounded beast with scars that never heal
Like a lion in, like a lion in, like a lion in a cage!
Lion in a cage!
